notes.title: Update Notes for 30th Apr
notes.content:
New updates are here! With chain infection bonus reward and tracker, you can now witness the diligence of your clones in action and receive bonus rewards from their hard work!

With each successful chain, you gain incremental bonus points to DNA and a unique praise word, coz nothing brightens a day like a good dose of fabricated applause. Chain countdown resets after 3 secs so hurry up.

Clones are "smarter" now that they will ignore any infected cells and only go for fresh kills. We still wanna keep them dumb so they don't end up taking over the player's job.

Pre-upgrade enabled at the start of a new stage. Freshen up with upgrades before commencing your next kill.

notes.content:
Bug fixes and game improvement include:

2. Option button added to enable change of setting (auto-pause) while playing.
3. Achievement bug resolved.

notes.title: New Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37575694/c0b7d4c21177238943aae306d02ea6677c5a9d54.png[/img]

The current update comes with a new pathogen, Entamoeba, a parasitic protozoa that feeds on cells. Take control of your reproduction via cell division and generate clones out of the reach of immune cells.

Game difficulty is bumped up a notch with the release of Natural Killer Cells, a relentless search-and-destroy immune cells that specifically hunt down players when activated.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
This new update will add about 30-45 minutes of play time.

Added: 
1. Additional enemy unit types and boss levels.
Fixes:
1. Improved loading time between levels and upgrade.
2. Minor touch-up and improvement to environmental design.

tags.feature: 1. Additional enemy unit types and boss levels.

notes.title: Updated Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37575694/3d9ef2972d67a83dd408ce71b1ea384b0436450e.png[/img]


Hello there! A new patch #1 is out now.

Added:
- New Epilogue for FLU virus character.

Fixes:
- Improved game pace for early stages to prevent deadlock and improve game flow.
- Improved character upgrade frequency to allow players to upgrade more often than previous version.
- Improved tutorial notification.
- Improved game sensing to enable players to "know" when their viral clones have destroyed cells outside the screen.

Happy playing!
